dimensions.assessment: Affects AmeriCorps participants and alumni who receive national service educational awards or related student loan discharge payments.
dimensions.evidence: gross income shall not include any amount received under a national service educational award

dimensions.assessment: Provides tax relief by excluding educational awards and loan repayments from taxable gross income for eligible individuals.
dimensions.evidence: provide an exclusion from gross income for AmeriCorps educational awards

dimensions.assessment: Reduces federal tax revenue by exempting certain educational awards from income tax, though exact revenue loss amounts are not stated in the source.
dimensions.evidence: provide an exclusion from gross income for AmeriCorps educational awards

dimensions.assessment: Amends sections 117(c) and 108 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to add specific tax exclusions.
dimensions.evidence: Paragraph (2) of section 117(c) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to taxable years ending after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply to taxable years ending after the date of the enactment of this Act.
